items.text: The revelation of her Koloss ancestry in the second-to-last installment of the Pits of Eltania nearly set off riots in Elendel's streets, so a special broadsheet with the finale came out the next day.

appearance.text: Slim, with long hair, glasses and bracelets; Jak calls her extremely beautiful. Her skin has a faint blue tint from her Koloss ancestry, which she hides under makeup and gloves.
